interaction_rules: Action panel enables only during player turn; disabled/greyed out otherwise
Bet/Raise amount constrained: min = 2x last raise (min-raise), max = remaining stack (all-in); invalid amounts disable confirm button
Quick bet sizing buttons: 1/3 pot, 1/2 pot, 2/3 pot, pot, all-in
Fold confirmation dialog when player has invested > 20BB in current hand
End session requires confirmation dialog with P&L summary
Illegal actions (e.g. Check when facing bet) hidden rather than shown as disabled
BOT thinking delay 0.5-1.5s with pulse animation to simulate natural play
Card deal animation 0.2s per card flip
Replay data loading shows skeleton placeholder
History list loads with skeleton, 20 items per page with virtual scroll
Date range filter applies immediately on selection without submit button
beforeunload warning when hand is in progress
IndexedDB write failure shows non-blocking toast notification
Decision color coding: green (#22c55e) for EV diff < 0.5BB, yellow (#eab308) for 0.5-2BB, red (#ef4444) for > 2BB
Multi-way pot EV displays warning icon with tooltip about approximation
Side pot scenarios marked as reference-only EV
Minimum viewport width 1024px; smaller screens show desktop-only message
Immersive table view with collapsed navbar during gameplay
